newsitem.title: USA: Chronimed adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Chronimed adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Chronimed Inc said Wednesday its board adopted a shareholder rights plan in which preferred stock purchase rights will be distributed as a non-taxable dividend.
In a statement, president Maurice Taylor II said the plan was not being adopted in response to any acquisition or merger proposal.

Chronimed, a health care company, said each right will entitle stockholders to buy one one-thousandth of a newly issued share of Series A junior participating preferred stock of the company at an exercise price of $120.
The rights will be exercisable only if a person or group, other than an exempted person, acquires or makes a tender for 15 percent or more of the company's outstanding common.

The company's board will be entitled to redeem the rights at $0.01 per right at any time prior to a person or group acquiring 15 percent or more of the common stock. Otherwise, the rights will expire on December 18, 2006.
